description: Harbor health, storage, API traffic, registry, jobs, projects and runtime. Shared Data source, Cluster and Namespace selectors filter every metric panel. The optional Database — pgx (8gcr) row requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring; its notes explain empty results.

panels.description: Up/down per Harbor component as reported by the exporter's health probe.
panels.title: Components

panels.description: Version and auth configuration from harbor_system_info.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, harbor_version, auth_mode, self_registration) (harbor_system_info{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Instance

panels.description: harbor_health: 1 healthy, 0 unhealthy (min across selected namespaces).
panels.title: Health

panels.description: Storage as tracked by Harbor (blob sizes plus system artifacts), not the bucket size.
panels.title: Storage

panels.description: Total projects.
panels.title: Projects

panels.description: Total repositories.
panels.title: Repositories

panels.description: Harbor-tracked storage over time.
panels.title: Storage used

panels.description: Public vs private project count.
panels.title: Projects

panels.description: Artifact count per type (IMAGE, CHART, SBOM, ...), all projects.

targets.expr: sum by (artifact_type) (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name, artifact_type, public) (harbor_project_artifact_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}))

panels.title: Artifacts by type

panels.description: Resident memory per Harbor process. This is what OOM-kills a pod.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (process_resident_memory_bytes{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Memory (RSS)

panels.description: CPU cores used per Harbor process.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (rate(process_cpu_seconds_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: CPU

panels.description: Goroutines per process. A steady climb is a leak.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (go_goroutines{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Goroutines

panels.description: Open file descriptors per process (sockets, files). Compare with process_max_fds, usually 1M on Kubernetes.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (process_open_fds{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Open file descriptors

panels.description: Bytes received per process.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (rate(process_network_receive_bytes_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network receive

panels.description: Bytes sent per process.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (rate(process_network_transmit_bytes_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Network transmit

panels.description: Median garbage-collection pause per process.

targets.expr: max by (cluster, namespace, service, pod) (go_gc_duration_seconds{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", quantile="0.5"})

panels.title: GC pause p50

panels.description: Core HTTP request rate grouped by status class.
panels.title: Requests by status class

panels.description: 90th percentile request duration per API operation, ten slowest (summary quantile reported by core).
panels.title: p90 latency by operation (top 10)

panels.description: Requests currently being handled by core.
panels.title: In-flight requests

panels.description: Share of core requests answered with 4xx or 5xx. Includes expected 401 token handshakes and 404 HEAD probes.
panels.title: Error rate

panels.description: Operations producing the most error responses.
panels.title: Top 10 operations by errors (4xx+5xx)

panels.description: 404s by operation and method. HEAD manifest/blob 404s are normal client probing.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (operation, method) (rate(harbor_core_http_request_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", code="404"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Top 10 operations by 404

panels.description: 5xx responses only; anything here needs a look.
panels.title: Server errors (5xx) by operation

panels.description: Distribution registry request rate by handler and method (manifest, blob, blob_upload, tags, ...).
panels.title: Requests by handler

panels.description: 90th percentile registry request duration per handler.
panels.title: p90 latency by handler

panels.description: Requests currently being handled by the registry.
panels.title: In-flight requests

panels.description: Share of registry responses that are 5xx.
panels.title: Registry 5xx

panels.description: Bytes served and received by the registry. Blob GETs redirected to object storage (307) are not counted as egress.
panels.title: Throughput

panels.description: 90th percentile latency of storage driver calls (Stat, GetContent, PutContent, Delete, List, Move, RedirectURL).
panels.title: Storage backend p90 latency

panels.description: Storage driver call rate by action.
panels.title: Storage backend calls

panels.description: Hit ratio of the Redis blob-descriptor cache. Misses turn into Stat calls on the storage backend.
panels.title: Blob descriptor cache

panels.description: Blob-descriptor cache errors (Redis unreachable or timeouts).
panels.title: Cache errors

panels.description: Proxy-cache project requests served from cache (hit) vs fetched upstream (miss), per project. Needs Harbor with the core proxy counters (goharbor/harbor#23578); empty on older releases or without proxy-cache projects.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, project) (rate(harbor_core_http_registry_proxy_requests_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) - sum by (cluster, namespace, project) (rate(harbor_core_http_registry_proxy_upstream_requests_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Proxy cache

panels.description: Successfully finished jobservice tasks per second, by job type.
panels.title: Task rate by type

panels.description: Failed or stopped tasks per second, by job type.
panels.title: Failed tasks by type

panels.description: Pending tasks per job queue. A growing queue means workers cannot keep up.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (max by (cluster, namespace, type) (harbor_task_queue_size{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}))

panels.title: Queue size by type

panels.description: Age of the oldest pending task per queue.

targets.expr: max by (type) (max by (cluster, namespace, type) (harbor_task_queue_latency{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}))

panels.title: Queue latency by type

panels.description: 90th percentile processing time per job type.
panels.title: p90 task duration by type

panels.description: Tasks currently executing per job type.

targets.expr: sum by (type) (max by (cluster, namespace, type, pool) (harbor_task_concurrency{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}))

panels.title: Running tasks by type

panels.description: Number of periodic schedules registered (scan-all, GC, retention, replication, ...).
panels.title: Scheduled jobs

panels.description: Number of jobservice replicas reporting (one harbor_jobservice_info series each). Worker slots per replica are in the table.
panels.title: Jobservice replicas

panels.description: One row per jobservice replica.
panels.title: Worker pools

panels.description: Quota fill per project, top 15. Projects with unlimited quota (-1) are excluded.

targets.expr: topk(15, max by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (harbor_project_quota_usage_byte{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) / (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (harbor_project_quota_byte{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}) > 0) * 100)

panels.title: Quota usage

panels.description: Quota-tracked storage per project (projects above 1 MiB).
panels.title: Storage by project

panels.description: Artifact pulls per minute per project (5m average), top 10.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (rate(harbor_artifact_pulled{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[5m]))) * 60)

panels.title: Artifact pulls per minute by project

panels.description: Top 10 projects by repository count.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name, public) (harbor_project_repo_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})))

panels.title: Repositories by project

panels.description: Top 10 projects by artifact count (all types).

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name, artifact_type, public) (harbor_project_artifact_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})))

panels.title: Artifacts by project

panels.description: Top 10 projects by member count.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (max by (cluster, namespace, project_name) (harbor_project_member_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})))

panels.title: Members by project

panels.description: Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

options.content:
**[8gcr](https://container-registry.com/8gcr/) feature.** These panels require PostgreSQL monitoring with `POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true` and metrics scraping enabled.

Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. **No data** can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

panels.title: About PostgreSQL/pgx monitoring

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Connections used and idle, and total configured pool capacity, summed across replicas of each service within a cluster and namespace.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (db_client_connections_usage{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", state="used"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (db_client_connections_usage{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", state="idle"})
sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (db_client_connection_max{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Pool connections

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Seconds per second spent waiting for a free pool connection. Non-zero means the pool is saturated.
panels.title: Acquire wait

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Acquires that had to wait for the pool, and acquires canceled by context (request timeouts).
panels.title: Acquires waiting or canceled

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

PostgreSQL operation latency across all Harbor processes.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (cluster, namespace, le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.9, sum by (cluster, namespace, le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (cluster, namespace, le) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_bucket{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Query latency

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Database operations per second by type (query, batch, prepare, connect, copy_from).
panels.title: Queries by type

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Operations that returned an error, by PostgreSQL status.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, pgx_status) (rate(db_client_operation_duration_seconds_count{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}", pgx_status!="OK"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Query errors

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Average time to get a connection from the pool (total acquire duration / acquires).

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (rate(pgx_pool_acquire_duration_seconds_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (rate(pgx_pool_acquires_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Mean acquire time

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Pool connections opened and closed per second, with the close reason.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service, reason) (rate(pgx_pool_connections_destroyed_total{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Connection churn

panels.description:
Requires 8gcr PostgreSQL monitoring with POSTGRESQL_METRICS_ENABLED=true and metrics scraping enabled. Standard Harbor does not expose these metrics. Empty panels can also mean monitoring is disabled or no matching metrics were scraped.

Connections currently being constructed.

targets.expr: sum by (cluster, namespace, service) (db_client_connections_pending_requests{service=~".*harbor.*", cluster=~"${cluster:regex}", namespace=~"${namespace:regex}"})

panels.title: Pending connection requests
